text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser suffered defeat at the 
hands of a perfectly prepared Ikuno 
Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shrugging off her frustration, she looks 
ahead... She even receives kind words from 
Ikuno Dictus, who says, "Because you were 
there, I never let my guard down."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, at Ikuno Dictus's 
recommendation, the two visited a public 
bathhouse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to recover from my fatigue 
thoroughly and get ready for the next 
race!
